root_cause: Required test preflight used git diff --name-only eventBase PRHead, not GitHub's merge_base_commit, to classify a PR whose branch lagged behind protected main. That counted unrelated newer main changes as candidate scope changes and failed SCOPE_CONTAMINATED.

evidence.actual_sql_timeout_separate: cron #46 run 121523 failed after 120s and remains not live-fixed

fix: For PR / owner-preserving workflow dispatch use GitHub Compare verified merge_base_commit SHA as changed-path and downstream integration base; validate provider base identity and SHA; keep merge_group/non-PR event diff and all strict scope-budget/security gates.
prevention_rule: Never classify two-dot PR versus advanced main as branch-owned changes. Provider-base mismatch, untrusted or behind comparison must fail closed. Real branch changes outside Change-Scope remain SCOPE_CONTAMINATED. No owner branch edits or bypasses.
